A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we identified a number of genetic alterations in PTCs from patients exposed to radiation.

we identified RET/PTCs, ETV6-NTRK3, and other driver mutations, and we also found that RET/PTC and ETV6-NTKR3 rearrangements are associated with radiation exposure, but that the presence of these mutations are not associated with clinical outcome.

thyroid tumors that develop in response to radiation exposure are not a homogeneous disease and can harbor a variety of genetic alterations.
